title: Toward all-optical unsupervised Hebbian learning in deep photonic neuromorphic networks
abstract: arXiv:2601.22300v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a deep photonic neuromorphic network (PNN) architecture based on phase-change material (PCM) synapses and local optical feedback for online, unsupervised Hebbian learning. The proposed architecture combines optical vector-matrix multiplication, non-volatile PCM synaptic weighting, and local coincidence-driven synaptic adaptation within a multilayer photonic crossbar framework compatible with photonic integrated circuits. Unlike conventional PNNs that rely on externally computed gradients, repeated optical-electrical-optical conversions, or global backpropagation, the proposed framework employs local Hebbian learning governed directly by correlated pre- and post-synaptic optical activity. To investigate the feasibility of the proposed learning mechanism, we implemented the PNN design using fiber-optic components, programmable variable optical attenuators, and real-time software control that incorporates PCM thermal dy

translated_title: 迈向全光学无监督Hebbian学习的深度光子神经形态网络
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.22300v4 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们提出了一种基于相变材料（PCM）突触和局部光反馈的深度光子神经形态网络（PNN）架构，用于在线、无监督的Hebbian学习。所提出的架构将光学向量-矩阵乘法、非易失性PCM突触加权以及局部符合驱动的突触适应相结合，集成在一个与光子集成电路兼容的多层光交叉框架中。与依赖外部计算梯度、重复的光-电-光转换或全局反向传播的传统PNN不同，该框架采用由突触前后光学活动直接相关的局部Hebbian学习机制。为了研究所提出的学习机制的可行性，我们使用光纤组件、可编程可变光衰减器和包含PCM热动力学的实时软件控制实现了PNN设计。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于相变材料和局部光反馈的全光学深度光子神经形态网络架构，实现无需外部梯度或全局反向传播的在线无监督Hebbian学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an all-optical deep photonic neuromorphic network architecture based on phase-change materials and local optical feedback, enabling online unsupervised Hebbian learning without external gradients or global backpropagation.
